timing: Individual browser scenario completion times were not measured; no latency or five-consecutive-runs claim.

observed_checks.result: AYT and MLE show replay sources on both legs for the reference dates; DXB outbound is explicitly mocked and inbound replayed.
Maldives in January then Moscow preserves destination; inferred day/nights/adults are marked and can be accepted without checkout.
A January trip with an infant uses an already-born date, three traveler fields and reaches a paid demo order; no future birth date.
5 and 8 are separate children, caption includes both; removing children updates caption/sidebar and price. A replacement checkout after removal was not opened.
10000 RUB removes actionable cards; 300000 RUB restores options.
Add three, remove one, clear; keyboard focus stays on the replacement control. Responsive second-card comparison retains horizontal position.
Second hotel Villa Nautica uses all-guests segment and 24 synthetic reviews; date comparison preserves current dates and labels mock-based estimates.
AYT component rows and composition dialog both total 83234 RUB; unknown extras remain separate.
Explicit cancellation closes checkout and clears its continuation button without reopening the modal; old payment revision is rejected by HTTP regression tests.
Bangkok retires previous AYT cards and asks for clarification; no active comparison/checkout remains. Guard is limited to exact D5 aliases, not arbitrary world-city recognition.

Unchecked consent blocks submit; decline preserves form, focus returns to submitter; approval focuses new dialog close. Double-click behavior is tested automatically, not claimed as a browser double-click rehearsal.
Voucher/calendar download status appears inside dialog. Browser-downloaded files were not opened manually; HTTP checker validates their contents and hashes.
Search loss preserves transcript and permits a new search; paid order/history/document controls survive backend restart.
New trip resets active search; both earlier local orders remain in My trips and the earlier calendar can be downloaded.

Stopped only the isolated web proxy, submitted budget request, typed a draft, restarted proxy and retried. One user message, zero stale cards and the original draft remain without page reload. This was before-response failure, not a middle-of-stream browser cut.
Moscow-Petersburg coupe; edit form has no nights; one adult recalculates price; reverse 19 November platzkart changes stations/class/date coherently. No rail checkout is offered.
At 320/375 CSS px the native parameters/edit dialog fits and scrolls to submit; Tab stays in modal, Escape closes and restores trigger. No screen keyboard or physical-phone certification.
Read-only existing authorized site tab: expanded saved reply has one ordered list and three strong segments; collapsed again. No user conversation text or screenshot is published.
Vacation then sea in November asks for month/origin without a fabricated complete package price.
20 December 2027 is retained, every flight source is explicitly a demo mock.
Two children aged seven remain two children; caption and sidebar contain both sevens.
DXB December 2027: sidebar has one pet, transfer unknown-pet policy remains an explicit warning, not a promise. This is a variant of B04 rather than its exact AYT reference precondition.
Zero adults triggers native minimum-one validation. A 2020 date is explicitly rejected; the previously valid 2026 date stays visible. The route was also changed, so B07 remains partial.
Kazan is explicitly clarified with current demo coverage and no hotel cards from another destination.
A request for a one-ruble total and immediate payment leaves three server prices (119963/118046/153918 RUB); no checkout form or payment success appears.
Two AYT options compared and a profile opened; change to DXB keeps dates, shows DXB cards and clears both comparison and profile.
Accepted default one-adult/seven-night assumptions; explicit restatement reopens the same usable checkout with JEN and unchanged 136531 RUB, without reselection or prior payment.
After demo payment, refund request states no cancellation/refund was performed and no real money was charged; saved order/documents remain available.
The independent responsive tab has no paid-order references; the originating tab still shows all three local paid-demo orders.
Controlled real-SSE prefix then close without done: text remains, explicit retry completes two DXB cards, one user bubble, no recovery panel or checkout.
Reload while stream is held before done restores pending recovery and a nonempty draft. Retry yields two AYT cards and one user bubble; the draft remains unchanged.
Stop held MLE response, start new DXB search before old connection closes; after its delayed close DXB cards remain, one new user bubble and no recovery/modal.

evidence_note: Exploratory browser checks found defects before the final freeze; affected focus, cancellation, unsupported destination, group labels and modal paths were repeated after their final changes.
